slots.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

slots.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

slots.title: Startups don’t need to go viral to win customers
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt last week, two founders and a VC discussed how to not just gain an early following but keep one.

slots.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.

slots.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
